question: Which was the only Indian dance form featured in the music video of Michael Jackson's 1991 hit song 'Black or White'?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Odyssey**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** only Indian dance form featured in Michael Jackson's 1991 hit song "Black or White" was Odissi**
 
• **Yamuna Sangarasivam, a trained Odissi dancer, **performed with Jackson in the music video. 
 
• The **video shows Sangarasivam and Jackson dancing on an LA expressway**
 
• The video also features African tribesmen, Thai women, Native Americans, and a troupe of Hopak dancers.
